# temps_admin_gate_settings (Resource)

Which hostnames and client addresses may reach the console and API. A list that leaves out the address the provider connects from locks it out. Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are.

Import with `admin_gate_settings`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check allowed_ips includes the address you manage Temps from:
# a wrong value locks you out of the console and the API.
resource "temps_admin_gate_settings" "this" {
  allowed_hosts       = ["temps.example.com"]
  allowed_ips         = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
  trust_forwarded_for = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_hosts` (List of String) Hostnames the console answers on; any when empty.
- `allowed_ips` (List of String) Client addresses or networks allowed; any when empty.
- `trust_forwarded_for` (Boolean) Take the client address from `X-Forwarded-For`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `admin_gate_settings`.
- `source` (String) Where the effective settings come from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_admin_gate_settings.this admin_gate_settings
```
